# v0.3.13 — Background model button beside the model menu

## What's changed

- When TheOne is the selected model, a **Background** button appears beside main chat's model menu. It shows which model does the routing and the background work, and switches it: follow DSH's default model, or pin any model configured in DSH. The choice is the same as **Model** in TheOne's settings and applies right away; the reasoning levels in the model menu follow the chosen model.
- The TheOne group in the model menu is back to a single **TheOne** entry. Sessions that picked one of the 0.3.10 "TheOne · <model>" entries keep working.

Validation: automated tests, type checks and packaging passed.

### Install or update

Click **Update** on the TheOne entry in the sidebar (0.3.11 or later), or reinstall from `https://github.com/YunongDai2005/dsh-theone` or npm `dsh-theone`.

## 中文

- 选中 TheOne 时，主聊天的模型按钮旁边会出现 **后台** 按钮，显示并切换分配话题和后台干活用的模型：跟随 DSH 默认模型，或固定为 DSH 中配置的任一模型。它与 TheOne 设置里的「模型」是同一项，切换后立即生效；模型菜单里的推理等级会跟着所选模型变化。
- 模型菜单里的 TheOne 分组恢复为只有一个 **TheOne**。在 0.3.10 中选过「TheOne · 某个模型」的会话仍可正常使用。

已通过自动化测试、类型检查和打包。

### 安装或更新

在侧边栏 TheOne 入口点 **更新**（0.3.11 及以上），或通过 `https://github.com/YunongDai2005/dsh-theone`、npm `dsh-theone` 重新安装。
